allowed_decisions: ordering of code-owned unit_ids within request-declared constraints
request-enumerated caveat anchor and before-or-after placement
candidate_model_protocol.audience_profile_source: caller-owned discourse_request.audience_profile; immutable for baseline and candidate
candidate_model_protocol.invalid_output_effect: record protocol failure; never repair into a publishable plan and never alter baseline publication

atomic_publication: write request, exact-baseline plan, eligibility record, verification record, and rendered output to a staging directory
recompute all canonical digests and verify every gate
atomically rename the complete staging directory
write the terminal receipt last and never overwrite a closed run
custody_and_replay.canonicalization: repository canonical JSON bytes with sorted keys, UTF-8, no NaN, and exactly one trailing LF
identity_pins: source revision and clean index/worktree state
request, schema, sentence catalog, renderer, optimizer implementation, eligibility record, plan, and publication-record SHA-256
exact deterministic objective version and canonical decision-key version
local-model manifest, artifact digest, runtime, decoding, and environment only if a later reviewed eligibility amendment authorizes inference
custody_and_replay.offline_replay: rebuild the exact deterministic baseline and publication record from committed safe artifacts without a model or network
custody_and_replay.private_data_rule: persist repository-relative identities and digests only; no host paths, environment dumps, credentials, or raw prompts

decision_rule.current_conclusion: implement deterministic v5 first; prove exact deterministic dominance; stop before model inference unless eligibility is independently established
decision_rule.model_value: No model value is measurable under this contract's current endpoint set because exact deterministic code optimizes every valued objective and all remaining differences are non-value diagnostics or costs.
no_value: the pre-inference eligibility gate remains false
a candidate cannot strictly exceed exact-baseline optional utility while satisfying the same gates
a candidate matches utility but emits more bytes
a candidate changes only ordering or caveat placement without a separately preregistered human endpoint
a candidate adds latency or tokens
a candidate is invalid, non-replayable, or violates parity
decision_rule.required_action: do not authorize local-model execution in this layer; retain the deterministic planner and remove the model from the authorization path

deterministic_baseline.algorithm: enumerate the complete finite feasible discourse-plan set and select its exact lexicographic optimum; an equivalent dynamic-programming or branch-and-bound implementation is allowed only if it proves the identical winner
candidate_generation: freeze the caller-owned audience_profile from the request
enumerate every mandatory-unit order allowed by code-owned ordering constraints
enumerate every optional-unit subset up to max_optional_units
enumerate every allowed position and caveat anchor/placement decision
render every otherwise-feasible candidate with the same deterministic renderer used for publication
discard every candidate that violates a feasibility gate or max_output_bytes
feasibility_gates: request and plan satisfy their exact schemas with no extra fields
audience_profile remains the caller-owned request value
every mandatory unit, fact, caveat, citation, and safety sentence is present exactly as required
every selected optional unit and caveat anchor is request-enumerated
all ordering, cardinality, protocol, and output-byte constraints pass
canonical renderer output passes mandatory fact/caveat coverage and citation validity at 100 percent

directions.objective: sum of request-pinned integer utility for selected optional units
exact UTF-8 byte length of deterministic renderer output

canonical_decision_key_fields: caveat_anchor_decisions sorted by caveat_unit_id then anchor_id then placement

deterministic_baseline.optimality_claim: The selected feasible plan is lexicographically optimal and Pareto-optimal for code-owned optional utility and emitted bytes; no heuristic or greedy approximation is permitted.

endpoints.value_note: deterministic planning latency is effectively zero relative to local inference and is not an endpoint a model can improve
the no-model baseline uses zero model input tokens
the no-model baseline uses zero model output tokens
ordering and caveat-placement differences are not value without a separately reviewed preregistered human endpoint
differences across different valid plans are non-comparable diagnostics under the current contract

model_eligibility.current_reason: Every current value endpoint is either a hard deterministic gate or an objective exactly optimized by deterministic code; plan ordering and caveat placement have no preregistered value endpoint, while inference latency and tokens are costs.
model_eligibility.evaluation_time: before any model process, inference request, prompt construction, model mutation, or model artifact acquisition
future_eligibility_requirements: a separately reviewed prospective contract amendment
a measurable objective that exact deterministic optimization cannot settle
a frozen comparison and statistical decision rule
all required identity, custody, stop, and failure rules
for subjective communication value, a properly blinded human-evaluation protocol declared before any model run

non_comparable_endpoints: subjective readability, coherence, preference, or communication quality without a separately declared blinded human protocol
ordering or caveat-placement differences under the current endpoint set
v3 or v4 latency and token measurements
any v5 fixture or synthetic contract-test output as observed model evidence

publication_contract.candidate_effect: diagnostic only after a future eligibility amendment; never authorizes or alters published claims
publication_contract.failure_isolation: model protocol/content failure is recorded and cannot corrupt the exact baseline, canonical safety prose, or publication record
publication_contract.renderer_ownership: trusted code owns all evidence values, source IDs, citations, caveats, clinical boundaries, and final sentences

research_question: Does a local model add measurable communication value beyond deterministic code once evidence claims and final prose are code-owned?

transitions: declared -> request_closed only after schema and identity validation
request_closed -> eligibility_checked before any model action
eligibility_checked -> deterministic_plan_selected with current model eligibility false
deterministic_plan_selected -> publication_staged only after exact-optimality proof and all gates
publication_staged -> publication_verified only after digest, coverage, citation, renderer, and budget replay
publication_verified -> published by one atomic rename
published -> closed by an immutable terminal receipt

stop_rules: stop before model inference when the eligibility gate is false
stop without publication if no feasible deterministic plan exists
stop on schema, identity, custody, replay, exact-optimality, coverage, citation, renderer, budget, or atomic-publication failure
stop a future eligible candidate on timeout, protocol error, unknown or duplicate ID, disallowed decision, digest mismatch, or non-deterministic replay
never retry or repair a model result into acceptance unless a separately reviewed future declaration explicitly defines bounded attempts
never weaken the deterministic baseline after seeing candidate behavior

v4_audit_basis.interpretation: post-hoc mechanical labels are not substantive unsafe-text truth and do not modify the frozen v4 result
